title: Raccoon holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M52 34 Q58 45 54 56' stroke='#9be89b' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='22' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#e8433f'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='22' rx='13' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#ff8a7a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='17' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffb3a8'/>

  <!-- raccoon body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='78' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#8a97b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='80' rx='14' ry='14' fill='#b7c2dd'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='72' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#6f7ba1' transform='rotate(-25 28 72)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='68' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#6f7ba1' transform='rotate(25 62 68)'/>

  <ellipse cx='56' cy='96' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#4f5a7d'/>

  <circle cx='63' cy='36' r='7' fill='#6f7ba1'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#e2a9b8'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='53' rx='18' ry='9' fill='#3b4468'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='57' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#c3cede'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='57' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#c3cede'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='51' r='4.5' fill='#d8e2f5'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='51' r='4.5' fill='#d8e2f5'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='51' r='2.6' fill='#1d2338'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='51' r='2.6' fill='#1d2338'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='50' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='50' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='59' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#22283f'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M41 63 Q45 66 49 63' stroke='#3b4468' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
